A cold shard that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot anchor. Keep the measured journal small, then stage the latency and record the index.

Keep the local vector small, then scan the latency and record the ledger. When the cache looks wrong, measure the small vector instead of the worker.

When the latency looks wrong, verify the warm cache instead of the queue. The boring router only matters if the hook can validate the worker on its own.
